translationRepairs: Tian Yi went out to meet his mother, younger brother, wife, and children and was captured by Liu Yan.
Tian Yi's mother, younger brother, wife, and children, whom he went out to receive, were captured by Liu Yan.
邑迎母弟妻子，為延所獲 is followed by 後邑聞更始敗…遣使詣洛陽, so Tian Yi remains free and acting; the capture object is the kin group he went out to meet, not Yi himself.
Yi went out to welcome his mother, younger brother, wife, and children, and was captured by Yan.
Yi went out to welcome his mother, younger brother, wife, and children, who were captured by Yan.
Same Chinese as r0001: 為延所獲 attaches to 母弟妻子; Yi continues as actor in the next sentence, so the literal must not make Yi the captive.
Someone said to him, 'Was not your husband the one who cursed you?'
Someone said to him, 'Was that not the one who cursed you?'
In the anecdote, after 取其長者 someone asks 夫非罵爾者邪; 夫 is the classical demonstrative pointing to that elder wife who had cursed him, not 'husband'.
